overview.title: A more selective agency model inside the group.
overview.intro: Based in Erlenbach, The Wearhouse Fashion Trade GmbH operates as an independent fashion agency within the Bollag-Guggenheim family. Its proposition is built around selective elevated fashion Brands and a close market attention.
overview.focus: The agency positions itself around curated premium/casual Brands and continuing to search for niche products and new discoveries.
